Italian-Thai Development Plc (ITD).desc: A Thai engineering and construction company founded in 1958 by Chaijudh Karnasuta and Giorgio Berlingieri, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since 1994, with the Karnasuta family holding about 24% as of January 2023.
